about: The review of each map's exact bytes (docs/decisions/0017-a-map-change-carries-a-review-of-its-bytes.md). tools/check-map-review.py fails any map whose sha256 is not the one recorded here.

corpus-map.json.note: compare.py read the map at 85e416f (40 entries) and exits 1 unless each of its 88 flags has a row in resolutions.json. The map was corrected to those rows in a5a4d66 (44 entries), and has not changed since. sha256 is the corrected map; compared.sha256 is the map before correction. The same comparator run against the corrected map raises 68 flags; those have no rows of their own (blind-mapping/README.md, Counts).
